Market today: The market is facing headwinds from rapidly rising interest rates and Treasury yields, with the 10-year topping 4.9% and mortgage rates over 7%. This signals tighter money and inflation fears, which typically pressure growth-oriented tech and chip names like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.06%) and SPAL (-33.28%) are in deep losses, are leveraged, and their listed stops are *above* current prices, which is a critical issue. SPY (3.15%) is also flagged SELL by the scanner. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further movements in Treasury yields and any signs of continued inflation. These will dictate the mood for your tech-heavy book.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and re-evaluate your stops, especially on leveraged positions, in this challenging rate environment.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far above the current 116.92, despite a -54% loss and SELL status. Review this urgently; consider cutting losses.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, your stop at 21.38 is above the current 16.78 with a -33% loss and SELL status. Re-evaluate this stop immediately.
SPY: Scanner says SELL. Consider respecting the 705 stop or trimming some exposure given the market's rate concerns.
